meeting-agenda-template-word.0: A meeting agenda template in Word is still the most common way US teams plan meetings, and the reasons are plain: it costs nothing, everyone has Word, and it prints cleanly for in-person sessions. The catch? Most downloaded templates are decoration. Nice fonts, zero structure that actually makes a meeting shorter.
